Entries.RangerFirstMet: A strange signal showed up on my radio recently.#$b#It's source is nearby, but it's broadcasting across the Gem Sea.$s#$b#I wonder what it could be?
Entries.RangerSettlesIn: That strange signal disappeared recently.#$b#I guess it was nothing to worry about!$h

Entries.RangerFirstMet: A new energy in the northern forest disturbs my protective barrier...#$b#It's yet to be seen whether the balance will tip towards ill or gain.#$b#...so go check it out and tell me what you find.
Entries.RangerSettlesIn: I'm pleased that Ms. Takahashi and the Ranger were able to resolve their issues without interference.#$b#I've decided to allow the Ranger to stay for now.#$b#The ferns grow richer with her presence.

Entries.RangerFirstMet: Someone pitched a tent deep in Cindersap Forest.#$b#I hope they're decent stewards of the land while they're camped here.
Entries.RangerSettlesIn: Taro should get rid of the title 'Ranger'.#$b#It's better to leave your ego behind as far as nature is concerned.
Entries.RangerHike: It's important to me that Leo thinks well of other people, even if I don't#$b#I don't want to teach the boy to be bitter...$s#$b#Taro is a decent role-model for him.

Entries.RangerSettlesIn: I wonder if the Ranger in the forest knows the old man on my island?#$b#They both have nice hats.$h
Entries.RangerHike: Ranger Taro has a neat big hat!$h#$b#I bet the parrots and I could weave a bunch of grass to make a hat like that.

Entries.RangerFirstMet: Someone in a park ranger uniform is hiking around the forest.#$b#I didn't know Cindersap was a Ferngill State Forest!$h
Some jerk in a ranger outfit is hanging around the woods behind the ranch.#$b#Marnie's not worried, but I sure am.#$b#We don't need another weirdo in this town.
